::: {.key-question}
How many people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander live in the NEPHU catchment and where do they reside?
:::

## Population Size

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Total population by Aboriginality, with age, sex, and LGA breakdowns
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in Census data
aboriginal_lga <- f_read_census_population(table = "G07", 
                                           level = "lga")

# Join to LPHU reference table
aboriginal_lga <- aboriginal_lga %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(lphu_assign, by = "LGA_CODE_2021") %>% 
  #
  janitor::clean_names()

# Aboriginal and non-Aboriginal peoples in each LPHU
results <- list()

for (i in lphu_names_short) {
  
  results[[i]] <- aboriginal_lga %>% 
    dplyr::filter(lphu_short == i) %>% 
    #
    janitor::adorn_totals(name = i,
                          fill = i) %>% 
    #
    dplyr::mutate(
      lga_id = dplyr::case_when(
        lga_code_2021 == i ~ i,
        TRUE ~ as.character(lga_id)))
  
  }

# Bind LPHU and Victorian data
aboriginal_lga <- results[["NEPHU"]] %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["SEPHU"]]) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["WPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["BSWPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["LMPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["GPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["GWSMPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["GVPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(results[["OMPHU"]]) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(aboriginal_lga %>% 
                     janitor::adorn_totals(name = "VIC",
                                           fill = "VIC") %>% 
                     #
                     dplyr::mutate(lga_id = dplyr::case_when(
                       lga_code_2021 == "VIC" ~ "VIC",
                       TRUE ~ as.character(lga_id))) %>% 
                     #
                     dplyr::filter(lga_code_2021 == "VIC"))

# Tidy up environment
rm(i, results)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Total population by Aboriginality, by LPHU
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
population_lphu <- aboriginal_lga %>%
  dplyr::filter(lga_name %in% lphu_names_short) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    aboriginal_prop          = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    aboriginal_prop_per_lphu = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
    #
    non_aboriginal_n             = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
    non_aboriginal_prop          = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    non_aboriginal_prop_per_lphu = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::bind_rows(aboriginal_lga %>% 
                     dplyr::filter(lga_name == "VIC") %>%
                     #
                     dplyr::mutate(
                       aboriginal_prop          = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       aboriginal_prop_per_lphu = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
                       #
                       non_aboriginal_n             = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
                       non_aboriginal_prop          = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       non_aboriginal_prop_per_lphu = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100)) %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    lphu_short = dplyr::case_when(
      lphu_short == "GPHU"    ~ "GRPHU",
      lphu_short == "GWSMPHU" ~ "GPHU",
      TRUE ~ as.character(lphu_short)),
    #
    lphu_long = dplyr::case_when(
      lphu_short == "NEPHU"  ~ "North Eastern (NEPHU)",
      lphu_short == "SEPHU"  ~ "South Eastern (SEPHU)",
      lphu_short == "WPHU"   ~ "Western (WPHU)",
      lphu_short == "BSWPHU" ~ "Barwon South West (BSWPHU)",
      lphu_short == "LMPHU"  ~ "Loddon Mallee (LMPHU)",
      lphu_short == "GRPHU"  ~ "Gippsland (GRPHU)",
      lphu_short == "GVPHU"  ~ "Goulburn Valley (GVPHU)",
      lphu_short == "GPHU"   ~ "Grampians (GPHU)",
      lphu_short == "OMPHU"  ~ "Ovens Murray (OMPHU)",
      lphu_short == "VIC"    ~ "Victoria",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(lphu_short,
                lphu_long,
                aboriginal_n = tot_indigenous_p,
                aboriginal_prop,
                aboriginal_prop_per_lphu,
                non_aboriginal_n = tot_non_indigenous_p,
                non_aboriginal_prop,
                non_aboriginal_prop_per_lphu)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [ABS Census 2021](https://www.abs.gov.au/census).

- NEPHU had the largest number of residents who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander in the 2021 Census for the state of Victoria (n = 12,065), representing 0.7% of the NEPHU catchment population. 

- 19% of Victorians who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander reside in the NEPHU catchment. 

- The proportion of people living in the NEPHU catchment who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander was lower than the proportion of people living in Victoria who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander (n = 65,639, 1.0% of the state population).

                 table_headers = c("LPHU",
                                   "Number of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people",

                                   "Percent of Victorian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander population"))

## Population Distribution and Density

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Total population by Aboriginality, by LGA
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
population_lga <- aboriginal_lga %>%
  dplyr::filter(lphu_short == "NEPHU" & lga_name != "NEPHU") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    aboriginal_prop         = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    aboriginal_prop_per_lga = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
    #
    non_aboriginal_n            = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
    non_aboriginal_prop         = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    non_aboriginal_prop_per_lga = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::bind_rows(aboriginal_lga %>% 
                     dplyr::filter(lga_name == "NEPHU") %>% 
                     #
                     dplyr::mutate(
                       aboriginal_prop         = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       aboriginal_prop_per_lga = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
                       #
                       non_aboriginal_n            = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
                       non_aboriginal_prop         = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       non_aboriginal_prop_per_lga = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100)) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(lga_name,
                aboriginal_n = tot_indigenous_p,
                aboriginal_prop,
                aboriginal_prop_per_lga,
                non_aboriginal_n = tot_non_indigenous_p,
                non_aboriginal_prop,
                non_aboriginal_prop_per_lga)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Total population by Aboriginality, by SA2
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in Census data
aboriginal_sa2 <- f_read_census_population(table = "G07",
                                           level = "sa2") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(sa2_code_2021 = as.character(sa2_code_2021))
  
aboriginal_sa2 <- aboriginal_sa2 %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(aboriginal_sa2 %>% 
                     dplyr::filter(sa2_code_2021 %in% nephu_sa2) %>% 
                     #
                     janitor::adorn_totals(name = "NEPHU") %>% 
                     #
                     dplyr::filter(sa2_code_2021 == "NEPHU"))

# Data wrangling
population_sa2 <- aboriginal_sa2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sa2_code_2021 %in% nephu_sa2) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(
    aboriginal_prop         = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    aboriginal_prop_per_sa2 = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
    #
    non_aboriginal_n            = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
    non_aboriginal_prop         = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
    non_aboriginal_prop_per_sa2 = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::bind_rows(aboriginal_sa2 %>% 
                     dplyr::filter(sa2_code_2021 == "NEPHU") %>% 
                     #
                     dplyr::mutate(
                       aboriginal_prop         = (tot_indigenous_p / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       aboriginal_prop_per_sa2 = tot_indigenous_p / sum(tot_indigenous_p) * 100,
                       #
                       non_aboriginal_n            = tot_non_indigenous_p + tot_indig_status_ns_p,
                       non_aboriginal_prop         = (non_aboriginal_n / tot_tot_p) * 100,
                       non_aboriginal_prop_per_sa2 = non_aboriginal_n / sum(non_aboriginal_n) * 100)) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::left_join(nephu_sa2.sf %>% 
                     dplyr::select(sa2_code, sa2_name),
                   by = c("sa2_code_2021" = "sa2_code")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(sa2_name = dplyr::case_when(is.na(sa2_name) ~ "NEPHU",
                                            TRUE ~ sa2_name)) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sa2_code_2021,
                sa2_name,
                aboriginal_n = tot_indigenous_p,
                aboriginal_prop,
                aboriginal_prop_per_sa2,
                non_aboriginal_n,
                non_aboriginal_prop,
                non_aboriginal_prop_per_sa2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Population density, by LGA
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
density_lga <- dplyr::left_join(nephu_lga.sf, 
                                aboriginal_lga %>% 
                                  dplyr::select(lga_name, tot_indigenous_p),
                                by = "lga_name") %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(pop_dens     = round(tot_indigenous_p / areasqkm, 1), 
                density_text = (paste0(lga_name, " LGA: ", format(pop_dens, big.mark = ","), " per square km")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Population density, by SA2
# Data from ABS Census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
density_sa2 <- dplyr::left_join(nephu_sa2.sf, 
                                aboriginal_sa2 %>% 
                                  dplyr::select(sa2_code_2021, tot_indigenous_p),
                                by = c("sa2_code" = "sa2_code_2021")) %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(pop_dens     = round(tot_indigenous_p / sa2_area, 1),
                density_text = (paste0(sa2_name, ": ", format(pop_dens, big.mark = ","), " per square km")))
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [ABS Census 2021](https://www.abs.gov.au/census).

- The majority of people living in the NEPHU catchment who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander reside in the Whittlesea (n = 2,270), Hume (n = 1,870), Yarra Ranges (n = 1,713), Darebin (n = 1,441), and Knox (n = 1,022) LGAs. 

- Despite having a smaller number of residents who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, these residents were concentrated in Darebin (27 people per km^2^) and Yarra (26 people per km^2^) LGAs. 

- The NEPHU catchment SA2s with the largest number of residents identifying as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander were Healesville - Yarra Glen (n = 373), Lilydale - Coldstream (n = 260), and Reservoir - North East (n = 248). 

- Despite having a smaller number of residents who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, these residents were concentrated in the SA2s of Collingwood (55 people per km^2^), Reservoir - North East (52 people per km^2^), Reservoir - South East (44 people per km^2^), and Fitzroy (41 people per km^2^).
